No boundary layer trip was used. Under normal operation, the floor and ceiling of the 2- by 2-foot tunnel are ventilated to a common plenum. The porosity for this test was set at 21 percent<sup>*</sup>. No corrections were made to the lift, drag, or pitching moment coefficient data. Figure 19 compares corrected and uncorrected data for this experiment. The angle-of-attack corrections shown in figure 19a are quite large at higher lift coefficients. In addition, unlike other ventilated tunnels, the slope of the angle-of-attack correction varies with Mach number. The effect of these large corrections results in excessive lift-curve slopes that are clearly erroneous whether shown as a function of Reynolds number or Mach number.
